summary: Frontend-only prelaunch correction validation completed on preview URL. Verified six required viewports, four question fixtures, SQL disclosure containment/internal scrolling behavior, tab order, product demo playback checkpoints, reduced-motion behavior, process sticky/fallback logic, controlled-access scenarios, CTA links, and build/hash integrity. Most requested corrections pass; one mobile overflow issue remains.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal page overflow on mobile when customer-decline content is active with disclosures open (doc_scroll_width exceeds viewport).

issues: Customer-decline chart/table region expands to ~447px width, causing page-level horizontal overflow instead of only local scrolling.

action_items: Constrain customer-decline chart/sample-data container on mobile to prevent page-level overflow; keep horizontal scroll local to intended scroller.
Re-run the provided matrix scripts after fix and confirm doc_scroll_width == client_width for all 24 viewport/question combinations.
critical_code_review_comments: SQL disclosure containment fix is effective: pre width now tracks inspector width and uses internal scroll safely.
Tab sequence is now correct across all tested viewports: Interpret -> Ground -> Compute -> Explain.
Validation checkpoint icon is neutral ring+dot with no checkmark, matching requested language/visual treatment.
Process behavior matches requested breakpoints: sticky at 1440x900 and row fallback at 1366x768, 1024x768, 768x1024.
Known existing console warnings (defaultMuted prop and non-static scroll container) still appear; treated as out-of-scope per request context.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/tests/prelaunch_matrix_playwright.py and /app/tests/prelaunch_additional_playwright.py against preview URL. Primary remaining failure is mobile overflow for customer-decline in workbench when disclosures are open. All other requested corrections validated as passing in this run.
rca of the issue: RCA: overflow is no longer from SQL <pre>; it now originates in customer-decline content region on mobile (measured content width ~447px at 390/360 viewports). Repro: open Workbench -> select customer-decline -> open required disclosures -> observe doc_scroll_width (484/480) > client_width (390/360). Mitigation: enforce min-width:0 and local overflow-x:auto containment on the specific customer chart/sample wrapper so document root width remains capped to viewport while preserving local horizontal scroll.
